title: Steering Lighthouse & People Playbook
summary: Quarterly all-hands focused on the new operating 'Lighthouse' priorities and a revised people playbook. Evan opened with business context and runway, Marco and Priya walked through product and infra asks, Sonia presented people changes (hiring cadence, role ladders, interview training). Several questions about hiring freeze, budget, and employee OKRs. Meeting closed with concrete action items and a follow-up town hall for managers.
action_items: Evan: Share updated 12-week runway slide and assumptions (2027-10-11)
Sonia: Publish revised hiring cadence doc and new role ladder templates (2027-10-13)
Marco: Run infra SLO post-mortem and circulate findings to engineering leads (2027-10-15)
Priya: Draft product rollout timeline for Dedicated improvements and share with GTM (2027-10-12)
Tomoko: Assemble research ramp plan for two new model onboarding projects (2027-10-20)
Liam: Schedule manager-only town hall for compensation Q&A (2027-10-14)
next_steps: Managers to review playbook and identify team-level impacts
People team to run interview calibration sessions next week
Engineering leads to submit capacity requests for Dedicated pilot by 2027-10-12
Finance to confirm comp budget cadence and communicate in manager town hall
transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2027-10-06 16:00 UTC
Duration: 72 minutes
Attendees: Evan, Sonia, Marco, Priya, Tomoko, Liam + all staff (remote)
Decks/links: people playbook draft (https://redwood.ai/decks/people-playbook), q4 lighthouse deck (drive link shared in chat)

[00:00] Evan Brooks: okay hey everyone thanks for joining on time, um trying to keep this tight 70ish minutes, we have a few big updates, some structural shifts we're calling the Lighthouse priorities for the next 12 weeks. quick housekeeping: recording is on, slides are in the chat.

[00:36] Sonia Patel: hi all, thanks. i'll start with the people playbook overview — this is a living doc, it's a set of changes we want to standardize across hiring, leveling, and manager expectations. high level: standard interview guides, role ladders, hiring cadence tied to business priorities, and a new calibration schedule.

[01:05] Evan Brooks: perfect, and to set context, from a business perspective runway is stable but tightening; we need sharper prioritization. Lighthouse is our signal to focus investment in product areas that move unit economics and retention.

[01:42] Marco Diaz: on infra we're tightening SLOs, we've seen tail latency spikes at certain payloads; Tomoko and infra have a joint investigation going. priority is to reduce 99th percentile token latency by 30% on Priority models. that reduces customer timeouts and lowers retry costs.

[02:18] Priya Nair: product will map features to Lighthouse buckets — Hosted API simplifications, Dedicated throughput wins, and Optimize tooling for cost signals. We'll begin canary rollouts mid-october.

[03:00] Tomoko Sato: research note — onboarding two community models for evaluation; quantization experiments will be batched into a single experiment matrix to avoid duplicated infra spend.

[03:36] Liam O'Connor: ops ask — please file capacity requests by next week; Dedicated pools need predictable commits to secure discounted GPU nodes.

[04:05] Evan Brooks: okay, now people specifics. Sonia?

[04:22] Sonia Patel: yes. main points: 1) no company-wide hiring freeze but a temporary slowdown on non-critical roles; 2) managers must submit hiring justification sheets mapped to Lighthouse categories; 3) revised role ladders published today — these are for calibration and comp planning, not final comp commit.

[05:00] A staff participant (Speaker 1): quick q, is comp cadence changing? last off-cycle was tough.

[05:18] Sonia Patel: not changing cadence, but timing may shift slightly; we'll be transparent in the manager town hall. Liam will run that.

[05:42] Evan Brooks: discretionary note — we're prioritizing customer-facing and infra roles this quarter. engineering R&D hires will be evaluated case-by-case.

[06:10] Marco Diaz: on calibrations — we'll run two interview calibration sessions (one for backend, one for inference infra) to reduce variance. Sonia, can hiring/ramp guides be in playbook?

[06:34] Sonia Patel: yes, already in the draft; also adding interview rubrics and a short 60-min interviewer training.

[07:05] Q&A kickoff (open mic)

[07:12] Jordan (Product): are we de-prioritizing any major roadmap items?

[07:28] Priya Nair: some exploratory experiments will be paused; feature launches tied to Lighthouse will get the investment. I'll circulate a trimmed roadmap.

[08:02] Speaker 2 (Finance): clarify runway assumptions? how conservative are we being on revenue?

[08:20] Evan Brooks: we're modeling a conservative base case — i'll send the slide with assumptions; the ask is for teams to plan for three scenarios (base/optimistic/downside).

[08:48] Anonymous in chat: can we get more granularity on Dedicated pricing and reserves?

[09:02] Priya Nair: yes — sales and finance are aligning on new reserved SKU and discounts; Marco will help with throughput profiles required for sales decks.

[09:36] Sonia Patel: manager guidance: 1:1 frequency and performance touchpoints are unchanged; but there's more emphasis on onboarding speed and measuring time-to-first-hello (TTFH?) — meaning time-to-meaningful-contribution for new hires.

[10:10] Evan Brooks: i want to emphasize transparency — we'll publish the playbook, then host a manager town hall next Thursday.

[10:32] Tomoko Sato: small comment — research needs a clearer path for short projects to avoid being deprioritized; propose a lightweight gating process.

[10:55] Evan Brooks: noted. we want to avoid bureaucratic slowdowns. keep experiments lean, measurable.

[11:20] Cross-talk/filler (brief)

[11:45] Sonia Patel: hiring cadence detail — hiring committees to be triggered only for senior roles; interviewers must use calibrated rubrics. action: interviewer training sessions next week sign-ups in the HR portal.

[12:10] Employee question: what about remote hiring and offices? are we closing offices?

[12:26] Evan Brooks: no closure plan; we are optimizing real estate spend but keeping hubs where critical. specific office changes will be communicated regionally.

[12:50] Marco Diaz: technical deep-dive teaser — we will run a latency/throughput benchmark week with partners; we plan to invite select customers to run workloads in a Dedicated pilot.

[13:20] Priya Nair: GTM note — this pilot will be limited to three customers and two internal teams for load testing; sign-ups will go through Solutions.

[13:55] Q&A continues, misc clarifications (comp timing, performance review cycles)

[14:40] Evan Brooks: okay let's switch to concrete commitments and next steps. Sonia, can you walk through manager next-step items?

[14:53] Sonia Patel: 1) Managers to review playbook with teams by next Monday; 2) Fill hiring justification forms for any reqs opened this quarter; 3) sign up for interviewer calibration. we'll post a recording and doc links.

[15:30] Liam O'Connor: ops action — we'll publish a capacity request template; please fill with model profiles and expected sustained qps.

[16:02] Closing: Evan Brooks: thanks everyone, appreciate frank questions. we'll follow up with the slides, a condensed FAQ, and manager town hall calendar invite. expect more transparency on comp timing within two weeks.

[16:20] Sonia Patel: last thing — check the HR portal, feedback channel is open for two weeks for this playbook draft.

[16:45] Post-meeting chatter and link shares in chat (people-playbook, q4-lighthouse deck)

Transcript notes: occasional stutters and overlapping talk, some names auto-transcribed oddly (e.g., "Lia m O'Conner"), timestamps approximate.

End of transcript.
